test_objective: Check that the JSON-LD @context is obtained from a Link header if present and that the default JSON-LD @context is used if not present

test_cases.name: 018_06_01 EmptyJsonLdContext
test_cases.template: Review JSON-LD Resolution When retrieving an entity
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Get Entity Request: and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/json' and
    Query Parameter: Link set to '<$${EMPTY}>; rel="http://www.w3.org/ns/json-ld#context";type="application/ld+json"'
}

test_cases.template: Review JSON-LD Resolution When retrieving an entity
